config.label: SignUpGenius login email (recommended)
config.description: SignUpGenius login email (recommended). Pair with SIGNUPGENIUS_PASSWORD for session mode — works on free accounts. No SSO/2FA.

config.label: SignUpGenius password (recommended) — required iff SIGNUPGENIUS_EMAIL is set
config.description: SignUpGenius password (recommended) — required iff SIGNUPGENIUS_EMAIL is set.

config.label: SignUpGenius Pro API key (Pro Tools > API Management)
config.description: SignUpGenius Pro API key (Pro Tools > API Management). Required only for slot REPORTS — Pro subscription needed.

config.label: Friendly account name used in startup logs
config.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.

config.label: Override the default JSON API base (v2/k for key mode, v3 for session mode)
config.description: Override the default JSON API base (v2/k for key mode, v3 for session mode).

config.label: Session mode only: override the host for legacy /SUGboxAPI
config.description: Session mode only: override the host for legacy /SUGboxAPI.cfm calls. Defaults to https://www.signupgenius.com.

config.label: Session mode only: override the login-form host
config.description: Session mode only: override the login-form host. Defaults to https://www.signupgenius.com.

config.label: Set to 1 to skip the fetchproxy browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI)
config.description: Set to 1 to skip the fetchproxy browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).
